title: A message from the dentist
instructions: Diş kliniği kısa bir sesli mesaj bırakıyor. Kısa ama değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Hello, this is a message for Mr Ali Demir from City Dental.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Your appointment is not on Monday the third. It is on Tuesday the fourth.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The time is the same, at two forty-five.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please come ten minutes early. Thank you.

questions.evidence: this is a message for Mr Ali Demir

questions.feedback: Randevu pazartesi değil, dördü salı günü.
questions.evidence: It is on Tuesday the fourth.
The time is the same, at two forty-five.
